body.name: Support-face tangent-cone route
body.construction: Restrict signed outcome perturbations to \(\mathcal Y^+_{s,x,u,w}\), retain only increments in the range of \(\mathscr L_{s,x,u,w}\), impose the coupled observed-cell equations directly when \(C_x\) has zeros, and use Farkas duality to obtain the annihilator of the resulting two-sided causal-completion tangent cone.
